headline: Mark Villar Joins Senate Majority, Takes Public Works Chair
seoTitle: Mark Villar Joins Senate Majority, Takes Public Works Chair
seoDescription: The Senate elected Mark Villar as public works chair and a Commission on Appointments member as he joined the 14-member majority bloc.
deck: The chamber elected Villar without objection to lead the public works panel and sit in the Commission on Appointments, expanding the majority to 14 senators.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Senator Mark Villar joined the Senate majority on October 8 and was elected chairman of the Committee on Public Works and a member of the Commission on Appointments. Majority Leader Juan Miguel Zubiri moved for the elections during the plenary session, and no senator objected, GMA News and Philstar reported.

The move raised the majority bloc to 14 members and left 10 senators in the minority. Villar replaced Senate President Vicente Sotto III as public works chairman and Zubiri in the Commission on Appointments, according to Philstar.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The Senate's official committee directory lists Villar as chair of the 13-member public works panel. Under Senate rules, the committee has jurisdiction over public buildings, highways, bridges, ports, airports, drainage, flood control, irrigation and water utilities.

Villar served as public works secretary from 2016 to 2021. Philstar also reported that he is among the respondents in an Ombudsman investigation involving PrimeWater joint ventures. That investigation is not a finding of wrongdoing, and FMB News is not linking it to the Senate's decision without evidence.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: The public works chair can shape hearings and legislation involving infrastructure, flood control and water utilities. The majority's larger bloc also affects committee control, chamber scheduling and votes during the ongoing impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch for the Senate's updated committee and Commission on Appointments rosters, Villar's first hearings as chair, and whether the new 14-10 alignment changes voting coalitions in the impeachment court or on infrastructure oversight.

audit.verificationNotes: GMA News, Philstar and News5 independently observed and reported the October 8 plenary action, including the absence of objections, the committee chairship, Commission on Appointments seat and 14-10 bloc count. The Senate's current official directory corroborates Villar's public works chairmanship, while the official composition page confirms the committee's jurisdiction. The Ombudsman matter is labeled as an investigation, not a finding. The image is FMB-owned editorial artwork and explicitly non-documentary.
